purpose: Existing plan progress presentation; no new normative architecture, acceptance, criteria, authority or task IDs.
source_format: H01 uploaded sample: Alan / Tahmini gelişim / Durum / Hazır olan / Eksik olan / Sıradaki iş. Format only; no other project evidence or estimated percentages imported.

measurement.reason: No approved per-stage task denominators. No estimates. Operational rollup is not weighted progress; overlapping section references do not count twice.

plan_checklist.definition: Evidence-backed completion of explicit plan milestones, equal weight within each row. Closed milestones include design/source review only when explicitly scoped as such. Not official weighted development, maturity or product acceptance; denominator is a reporting proposal now frozen in revision 2 pending H01 ratification.
plan_checklist.rollup: Operational rows are navigation views of shared detail IDs; do not sum or average them. No aggregate product percentage.
